items.title: Quintus Yukthi Opus (QYO) — Quantum-Classical Hybrid Metaheuristic
items.subtitle: Co-authored with Prof. Gajanan V Honnavar
items.description: Designed a four-layer pipelined architecture unifying SA warm-start, QWalk-MCMC exploration, and adaptive Grover amplification as a quantum machine learning hybrid; outperformed QAOA by 15.3–21.4 pp on Weighted Max-Cut (Cohen's d > 6.2, p < 10⁻⁶) at up to 9.0× faster runtime. Optimised quantum circuit compilation via candidate-index encoding, reducing qubit overhead 78% (O(n²)=36 → O(log K)=8); validated on IBM ibm_fez (156-qubit NISQ), TSP approximation ratio 1.0000 in 9.87 s, characterising gate error and decoherence at circuit depth 119.

items.title: Yukthi Opus (YO) — Classical Hybrid Optimization Framework
items.subtitle: Co-authored with Prof. Gajanan V Honnavar
items.description: Designed three-layer MCMC + greedy + adaptive SA framework; numerical analysis across 30 trials (t-test, Cohen's d) proved 30–36% quality degradation without MCMC or greedy (p < 0.01); reduced variance 55% via multi-chain execution. Ranked 2nd on Rosenbrock 5D with fastest runtime (0.061 s) vs. CMA-ES, BayesOpt, APSO; delivered 1.8% shorter TSP tours at N=200; open-sourced at github.com/DanushVikraman007/Yukthi_opus.

items.title: Origo Signum (Q-PUF) — Quantum Physical Unclonable Function
items.subtitle: Co-authored with Prof. Gajanan V Honnavar
items.description: Inverted quantum error correction principles to exploit NISQ decoherence as a controlled entropy source in a 3-qubit quantum software library circuit; achieved 9.38-bit Shannon entropy (≈91% of max) on IBM ibm_fez, validated across Qiskit Aer simulators.

items.title: Real-Time LiDAR 3D Object Detection Node
items.subtitle: ROS · MATLAB Coder · GPU Coder
items.description: Deployed an end-to-end ROS node running a pre-trained PointPillars model to generate real-time 3D bounding boxes, spatial orientations, and object classifications (Car, Truck) from raw point cloud frames. Used MATLAB Coder and GPU Coder to cross-compile algorithmic scripts into optimized, native CUDA-accelerated standalone executables for localhost deployment. Engineered an asynchronous pipeline utilizing custom sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 and std_msgs arrays to deserialize telemetry and dynamically overlay accurate cuboids onto live streams.

items.title: Project STHIRA — Bio-Mimetic EEG/fNIRS Digital Twin
items.subtitle: Quanad Laboratory, PES University
items.description: Designed and synthesised CuS quantum dot photoconductors (wet-chemical co-precipitation, 2.0 g yield, ΔR/R_dark > 10% at 850 nm) for the fNIRS metabolic veto core of a hybrid biosensor with concentric GQD-coated EEG ring and CuS fNIRS photoconductive centre. Implemented an ATP-gated Izhikevich spiking neural network (10,000–65,000 neurons/region, 4 neuron classes) driven by real-time dual-sensor EEG/fNIRS input; synaptic STDP updates triple-gated on EEG frequency band, fNIRS O₂ saturation (>0.65 SpO₂), and per-neuron ATP reserve — a metabolic honesty constraint absent from all standard ANN frameworks.

items.title: Quantum Computation for Cryptography
items.subtitle: Qiskit / IBM Quantum Experience
items.description: Implemented BB84 QKD circuits in Qiskit and benchmarked key error rate (QBER) across depolarising noise levels of 0–15%, confirming protocol abort-threshold behaviour on IBM Quantum Experience.
